image_description: A close-up view of a white toilet paper roll mounted on a wall dispenser. The dispenser is white with blue circular cutouts. A metal spring mechanism is visible through the central hole of the roll, holding it in place. A sheet of textured toilet paper hangs down from the bottom.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a cylindrical roll of wound paper. The geometry implies a core, though it is obscured by the mounting hardware.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions of the roll relative to the mounting bracket appear consistent with standard consumer toilet paper dimensions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While perforations are standard, the resolution and angle do not allow for definitive visual confirmation of individual perforation holes along the tear line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The hanging sheet clearly exhibits a bumpy, embossed texture consistent with quilted toilet paper manufacturing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The center of the roll is occupied by the metal spring mechanism of the dispenser, completely occluding the cardboard core.
The paper product is uniformly white/off-white, matching the expected appearance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface reflection is matte, and the texture appears fibrous and soft, consistent with paper pulp.
Specific separation lines are not resolvable at this image quality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is unmistakably a household paper product in the standard roll format.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The edges of the hanging paper sheet appear slightly too smooth and uniform, lacking the microscopic fraying or irregular fiber pull-out typical of unrolled paper. It has a slight 'melted' or overly soft boundary against the background.

The metal spring visible through the center hole appears geometrically inconsistent. The coils seem to merge into the background or the inner wall of the roll without clear physical separation or depth, suggesting a minor AI generation error in rendering complex thin structures inside hollow objects.

expert_verification_plan.target_subject: metal spring and roll core interface
verification_goals: Verify the spatial separation between the metal spring coils and the inner wall of the toilet paper roll.
Confirm the spring exists in a distinct depth plane from the paper roll to rule out structural fusion/collapse.
expert_verification_plan.reason: Directly addresses the Judge's feedback regarding the 'structural collapse' artifact. This expert is best suited to validate the 3D relationship and physical separation of the spring mechanism which appeared fused in the preliminary scan.

verification_goals: Segment the toilet paper roll to ensure it is a single, continuous topological entity.
Check for boundary bleeding between the roll's edge and the dispenser background.
expert_verification_plan.reason: Complements the depth audit by verifying the 2D connectivity and sharpness of the roll's boundaries, ensuring no floating parts or edge melting.

verification_goals: Analyze the hanging sheet for realistic fibrous texture vs. AI smoothing artifacts.
Evaluate the sharpness of the paper edges against the background.
expert_verification_plan.reason: To verify the subtle texture anomalies and edge softness observed in the preliminary scan, ensuring the material properties look physically correct.

verification_goals: Confirm the object is classified as toilet tissue/paper product.
Distinguish from similar cylindrical objects like tape rolls or paper towels.
expert_verification_plan.reason: Standard class verification. Weight reduced as class identity is visually obvious, shifting focus to structural integrity issues.

unverifiable_points: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
focus_areas: Geometric integrity of the metal spring mechanism within the roll core.
Depth separation between the spring and the paper roll.
Texture realism of the embossed paper surface.
Edge definition of the hanging paper sheet.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the metal spring and the inner wall of the toilet paper roll. The previous plan failed to adequately verify if the spring is physically separate from the roll or if it suffers from 'structural collapse' (fusion). Use the geometric depth auditor to confirm the spring sits in front of or inside the core with valid depth separation. Also, scrutinize the texture of the hanging paper; it should show distinct fibrous details rather than a smooth, plastic-like gradient.
